narr: Showers and thunderstorms developed over northwest Arkansas during the late morning of the 2nd and moved northeastward while expanding in coverage and intensity during the afternoon and evening as a strong upper level trough moved northeastward from west Texas toward the Missouri and Kansas border. The rain persisted until the late morning of the 3rd. Rainfall accumulations in excess of two inches occurred along and east of a line from Cassville to Osage Beach, with embedded accumulations over three inches near Lebanon, Houston and Salem. Low water crossings became flooded at many locations east of Springfield, and minor to moderate river flooding occurred along the Big Piney, Jacks Fork, Gasconade and James Rivers.
ev: Highway W at Pine Creek was closed at a low water crossing due to flooding.
